program_name: CORRECTION TO THE RESEARCH BRIEF, READ THIS FIRST. The brief states that this curriculum has NO dedicated English-language page and is 'only mentioned as a note on the Italian-language parent programme page'. That is HALF TRUE and the half that is false matters. It is TRUE that the orientation portal (orientamento.unina.it/corsidistudio/ingegneria-per-lambiente-e-il-territorio-lm/) exists ONLY in Italian - there is no English mirror of it (the ?lang=en and /corsidistudioen/ URL patterns that serve English fact-sheets for Federico II's fully-English degrees both return the identical Italian page for this degree) - and that on it the curriculum gets exactly ONE sentence. It is FALSE that no English page exists anywhere: the degree programme's own official site publishes a dedicated English page for this curriculum at https://www.iat.unina.it/environmental-sustainability/ , and an official ENGLISH-language study plan, 'ANNEX 1 - DEGREE PROGRAM DIDACTIC REGULATIONS - ENVIRONMENTAL AND TERRITORIAL ENGINEERING - CLASS LM-35', at https://www.iat.unina.it/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Annex_1_EN_LM_IAT_25-26.pdf . Most of this record is therefore sourced from official ENGLISH unina.it documents, not only from translated Italian. THE CURRICULUM. English name: 'Environmental Sustainability'. It is one of FOUR curricula inside a single Italian degree, and it is the only one taught in English. THE DIPLOMA. The qualification awarded is the 'Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria per l'Ambiente e il Territorio', degree class LM-35. Art. 1 of the binding Didactic Regulations gives the official English rendering of the degree: "Il presente Regolamento disciplina gli aspetti organizzativi del Corso di Studio in Ingegneria per l'Ambiente e il Territorio (nome in inglese: Environmental and Territorial Engineering), classe LM-35: Ingegneria per l'Ambiente e il Territorio." So the degree's official English name is ENVIRONMENTAL AND TERRITORIAL ENGINEERING. The curriculum name 'Environmental Sustainability' is a study-plan choice and does NOT appear in the legal name of the qualification - exactly the case the research brief anticipated. THE SINGLE MOST DANGEROUS NAMING TRAP IN THIS RECORD - THERE ARE TWO CURRICULA WITH THE SAME NAME, ONE ITALIAN AND ONE ENGLISH. The degree's Italian-taught 'traditional path' contains a curriculum called 'Sostenibilita Ambientale', whose literal English translation is 'Environmental Sustainability'. The English-taught curriculum is its English-medium TWIN, not a different subject. The two are formally separate curricula with separate course tables. The binding 2026/2027 study plan (Allegato 1) names them, in Italian, 'Curriculum Sostenibilita Ambientale in Italiano' and 'Curriculum Sostenibilita Ambientale in Inglese' - i.e. 'in Italian' and 'in English'. The 2026/2027 Manifesto degli Studi names the second one 'Curriculum "Environmental Sustainability"'. The programme website calls it '``Environmental Sustainability`` curriculum in English'. ALL THREE LABELS DENOTE THE SAME THING. An applicant or an adviser who asks for 'the Environmental Sustainability curriculum' without adding 'in English' / 'in Inglese' can be given the ITALIAN-taught curriculum by mistake. Always say 'Sostenibilita Ambientale IN INGLESE'. THE FOUR CURRICULA in full: (1) Sostenibilita Ambientale - ITALIAN; (2) Sostenibilita Ambientale in Inglese / 'Environmental Sustainability' - ENGLISH; (3) Dissesto Idrogeologico (Hydrogeological Instability) - ITALIAN; (4) Energia per l'Ambiente (Energy for the Environment) - ITALIAN. ADMINISTERING STRUCTURES. Department: Dipartimento di Ingegneria Civile, Edile e Ambientale (DICEA, Department of Civil, Architectural and Environmental Engineering, https://www.dicea.unina.it). School: Scuola Politecnica e delle Scienze di Base (Polytechnic and Basic Sciences School, SPSB). Teaching area: Ingegneria. Programme website: https://www.iat.unina.it . Duration 2 years, 120 CFU/ECTS, conventional in-person delivery. The degree has existed at Federico II since a.y. 1990-91. ADDITIONAL OPTIONS OPEN TO STUDENTS OF THIS DEGREE (all documented on official pages): a DOUBLE DEGREE with the University of Architecture, Civil Engineering and Geodesy (UACEG) of Sofia, Bulgaria - this is the Sofia partnership the brief mentions; a DOUBLE DEGREE with Kyungpook National University of Daegu, South Korea; a DOUBLE DEGREE with the Czech University of Life Sciences Prague; an INTERNAL double master's degree with Mathematical Engineering (6 semesters); and the 30-CFU Minor 'Green Technology Developer' certified by an Open Badge, run under the national 'Tecnologie per le transizioni' project with the Polytechnics of Bari, Milan and Turin and the Universities of Bologna, Padua, Palermo and Rome La Sapienza. The most recent official statement, a programme-site news item dated 3 July 2026, says verbatim: "Gli studenti interessati sono invitati a contattare la Coordinatrice del Corso di studio, prof. Alessandra Cesaro (alessandra.cesaro@unina.it), per maggiori dettagli." The orientation portal's 'Referenti del corso' block agrees: 'Alessandra Cesaro - Coordinatrice Didattica - 0817683445 - alessandra.cesaro@unina.it'. THREE OTHER NAMES ARE STILL PUBLISHED ELSEWHERE ON UNINA.IT AND ARE STALE: the central unina.it course record names 'Coordinatore: Prof. Francesco PIROZZI'; the 2024 and 2025 double-degree rectoral decrees and the International Course Catalogue name 'Prof. Massimiliano Fabbricino'; and the Catalogue's Kyungpook entry misspells him 'Prof. Massimiliano Fabbrocino' with the e-mail massimiliano.fabbrocino@unina.it and a telephone number (081-2536426) copied from an unrelated Law-department entry. Write to Alessandra Cesaro. level: MASTER - Italian 'Laurea Magistrale' (second-cycle degree, EQF level 7), 2 years, 120 CFU/ECTS. This CONFIRMS the 'level: master' given in the research brief. The central unina.it course record states 'Tipo di corso: Magistrale', 'Durata: 2 anni', 'Accesso al Corso: Laurea di 1 livello'. The orientation-portal fact-sheet header states 'Titolo di ingresso Laurea I Livello'. Art. 9 of the Didactic Regulations: "Lo studente dovra acquisire 120 CFU". CREDIT VALUE. Art. 6: "Ogni CFU corrisponde convenzionalmente a 25 ore di impegno formativo complessivo per ciascuno studente" - one CFU equals 25 hours of total student workload, so 120 CFU equals 3,000 nominal hours. Contact-hour conversion for this degree, also Art. 6: "Lezione frontale o esercitazione: 8 ore per CFU; Seminario: 6 ore per CFU; Attivita di laboratorio o di campo: 10 ore per CFU"; for the internship, one CFU equals 25 hours. NOTE this differs from several other Federico II engineering degrees, where a lecture CFU is worth fewer hours. EXAM CAP. Art. 9: "La laurea si consegue dopo avere acquisito 120 CFU con il superamento degli esami, in numero non superiore a 12, ivi compreso l'esame finale" - the degree is obtained after acquiring 120 CFU by passing NO MORE THAN 12 examinations, the final examination included. All the free-choice examinations together count as a single unit for that cap. HOW THE 120 CFU ARE SPLIT IN THE ENGLISH-TAUGHT ENVIRONMENTAL SUSTAINABILITY CURRICULUM (identical in the a.y. 2025/2026 and a.y. 2026/2027 study plans, and identical in the Italian Allegato 1 and the English Annex 1). YEAR 1 = 63 CFU of mandatory teaching: Energy Management 9; Environmental Hydraulics 9; Geographic Information Systems 9; Plants for the Treatment of Aeriform Effluents 9; Aqueducts and Sewers 9; Waste to Energy and Circular Economy 9 (an integrated course of two modules - 'Circular Bioeconomy for Ecological Transition' 6 CFU + 'Waste to Energy' 3 CFU, with a single examination); Safety in Chemical Processes 9. YEAR 2 = 18 CFU of mandatory teaching: Advanced Applied Engineering Mathematics 9; Wastewater Treatment and Reuse 9. PLUS, in Year 2: 'Tirocini formativi e di orientamento' (Training and orientation internship) 6 CFU / 150 hours, TAF F, in person, mandatory; and 'Prova finale' (Final test) 15 CFU, TAF E, mandatory. PLUS 18 CFU of freely-chosen courses. 63 + 18 + 6 + 15 + 18 = 120 CFU. ONE OPTIONAL COURSE IS EXPLICITLY OFFERED INSIDE THE CURRICULUM ITSELF: 'Geotechnical Risks in Urban Areas' (6 CFU, ICAR/07 - CEAR-05/A, TAF D), listed as 'A scelta' / 'Optional' and shown in BOTH Year 1 and Year 2 - i.e. it may be taken in either year against the 18 free-choice credits. TEACHING-ACTIVITY TYPES recorded for every taught course in this curriculum: 'Lezione frontale' / 'Frontal lesson', modality 'In presenza' / 'In presence'. There is NO online or blended option; Art. 7 states "L'attivita didattica viene svolta in modalita convenzionale." SEMESTER PLACEMENT (from the 2026/2027 Manifesto degli Studi, which the study plan does not give). Year 1 semester 1: Energy Management, Environmental Hydraulics, Geographic Information Systems, Plants for the Treatment of Aeriform Effluents. Year 1 semester 2: Aqueducts and Sewers, Waste to Energy and Circular Economy, Safety in Chemical Processes. Year 2 semester 1: Advanced Applied Engineering Mathematics, Wastewater Treatment and Reuse. Year 2 semester 2: internship and final examination. The 18 free-choice CFU are shown as '0-18' in every one of those four semester blocks, with footnote (a): "I 18 CFU per insegnamenti scelti autonomamente dallo studente sono collocabili sia al I che al II anno, al I o al II semestre" - placeable in either year and either semester. FINAL EXAMINATION, 15 CFU. Admission requires having acquired the study-plan credits, discharged any additional learning obligations, and paid all fees. The candidate presents work carried out under a supervisor before a Commission chaired by the Programme Coordinator, then discusses it. Presentation lasts 15 minutes, discussion a maximum of 5 minutes. Audio-visual support may be projected, or a summary booklet given to each commissioner. THE MARK: expressed out of 110, the sum of three components - (i) the examination average converted to 110ths, counting a mark of 31 for every exam passed 'con lode'; (ii) up to 3 points for the academic record; (iii) up to 5 points awarded by the Commission for the quality of the thesis and the candidate's presentation skills. THE THESIS MAY BE WRITTEN IN ENGLISH: "L'elaborato di tesi puo anche essere scritto in lingua inglese, specie se le attivita in esso descritte sono state svolte nell'ambito di programmi di ricerca e di internazionalizzazione." Graduation-session calendar: https://www.scuolapsb.unina.it/esame-di-laurea-collegio-degli-studi-di-ingegneria/ and https://www.iat.unina.it/calendario-esami-e-lauree/ . INTERNSHIP, 6 CFU / 150 hours. The programme maintains a wide portfolio of agreements with companies and public and private institutions; requests are made through the fully computerised 'Collabora' portal at http://collabora.unina.it . PROFESSIONAL OUTCOMES declared for the degree (ISTAT occupation codes): 'Ingegneri edili e ambientali' (Building and environmental engineers, ISTAT 2.2.1.6.1) and 'Ricercatori e tecnici laureati nelle scienze ingegneristiche civili e dell'architettura' (Researchers and graduate technicians in civil engineering and architecture sciences, ISTAT 2.6.2.3.1).
teaching_language: THE DEGREE AS A WHOLE IS BILINGUAL, NOT ENGLISH; ONE OF ITS FOUR CURRICULA IS FULLY ENGLISH, AND THAT CURRICULUM IS THIS ONE. The orientation-portal fact sheet records 'Lingua ITA/ENG'. Art. 1 of the Didactic Regulations: "Le lingue in cui si tiene il corso sono l'italiano e l'inglese" (the languages in which the course is held are Italian and English). THE ONE SENTENCE ON THE PARENT PAGE THAT ESTABLISHES THE ENGLISH CURRICULUM, verbatim: "L'offerta formativa si completa con il curriculum 'Environmental Sustainability', i cui insegnamenti sono erogati esclusivamente in lingua inglese." (The educational offer is completed by the 'Environmental Sustainability' curriculum, whose courses are delivered exclusively in English.) This is the note the research brief refers to, and the word used is ESCLUSIVAMENTE - exclusively. THE PROGRAMME'S OWN ENGLISH-LANGUAGE CONFIRMATION, from https://www.iat.unina.it/environmental-sustainability/ , verbatim: "The teaching courses planned for the Environmental Sustainability curriculum (fully delivered in English) within the M.Sc. degree in Environmental and Territorial Engineering are provided here. Please note that the organization of the teaching courses is in effect for students enrolled starting from the academic year 2025-2026." THE BINDING TABLE. The 2026/2027 study plan (Allegato 1 to the Didactic Regulations) lays out four curriculum tables, headed: 'Curriculum Sostenibilita Ambientale in Italiano'; 'Curriculum Sostenibilita Ambientale in Inglese'; 'Curriculum Dissesto Idrogeologico'; 'Curriculum Energia per l'Ambiente'. Only the second is in English. The 2026/2027 Manifesto degli Studi uses the heading 'Curriculum "Environmental Sustainability"' for the same table. THE COMPLETE ENGLISH-TAUGHT SYLLABUS (from the official English Annex 1 and the Italian Allegato 1, which agree course-for-course). Year I: Energy Management (9 CFU, SSD ING-IND/11 / IIND-07/B, TAF C, mandatory); Environmental Hydraulics (9 CFU, ICAR/01 / CEAR-01/A, TAF B, mandatory); Geographic Information Systems (9 CFU, ICAR/20 / CEAR-12/A, TAF B, mandatory); Plants for the Treatment of Aeriform Effluents (9 CFU, ING-IND/25 / ICHI-02/A, TAF B, mandatory); Aqueducts and Sewers (9 CFU, ICAR/02 / CEAR-01/B, TAF B, mandatory); Waste to Energy and Circular Economy (9 CFU total, ICAR/03 / CEAR-02/A, TAF B, mandatory, two modules: Circular Bioeconomy for Ecological Transition 6 CFU + Waste to Energy 3 CFU); Safety in Chemical Processes (9 CFU, TAF B, mandatory); Geotechnical Risks in Urban Areas (6 CFU, ICAR/07 / CEAR-05/A, TAF D, optional). Year II: Advanced Applied Engineering Mathematics (9 CFU, MAT/07 / MATH-04/A, TAF C, mandatory); Wastewater Treatment and Reuse (9 CFU, ICAR/03 / CEAR-02/A, TAF B, mandatory); Geotechnical Risks in Urban Areas (6 CFU, TAF D, optional); Training and orientation internships (6 CFU, 150 hours, TAF F, mandatory); Final test (15 CFU, TAF E, mandatory). Every taught course is delivered as a 'Frontal lesson' 'In presence'. All ten course titles are given in English in both the Italian and the English version of the study plan - the Italian document does not translate them, which is itself evidence that they are English-medium. THE THESIS MAY BE WRITTEN IN ENGLISH (Art. 16): "L'elaborato di tesi puo anche essere scritto in lingua inglese, specie se le attivita in esso descritte sono state svolte nell'ambito di programmi di ricerca e di internazionalizzazione." [uncertain] THE DECISIVE PRACTICAL CAVEAT - THE 18 FREE-CHOICE CFU ARE NOT GUARANTEED TO BE AVAILABLE IN ENGLISH, AND THIS IS A REAL GAP. Unlike some other Federico II English curricula, whose free-choice tables explicitly say the credits must be taken from English-taught courses, THIS curriculum imposes no such restriction. Art. 9 of the Regulations: "Per acquisire i CFU relativi alle attivita a scelta autonoma, lo studente ha liberta di scelta tra tutti gli insegnamenti attivati presso l'Ateneo, purche coerenti con il progetto formativo. Tale coerenza viene valutata dalla Commissione di Coordinamento Didattico del CdS." The parent page adds that the Manifesto merely 'indicates the recommended free-choice activities'. Since 15% of the degree (18 of 120 CFU) sits in this free-choice slot, and since the recommended lists in the Manifesto are drawn from the Italian-taught curricula, a student who cannot follow Italian must actively hunt for English-taught electives elsewhere in the University and have the Coordination Committee approve them for coherence. NOTHING PUBLISHED CONFIRMS THAT 18 CFU OF SUITABLE ENGLISH ELECTIVES ARE GUARANTEED. Raise this with Prof. Cesaro before enrolling - it is the single largest unresolved risk to the claim that the curriculum can be completed entirely in English. [uncertain] SECOND CAVEAT: university life outside the lecture theatre is conducted in Italian. The orientation portal page, the Manifesto, the Didactic Regulations proper, the double-degree calls, the study-plan procedure, the exam calendar and the student-office correspondence are all Italian-only; the English materials for this curriculum amount to one web page and one study-plan annex. Federico II itself does not require Italian for English-taught programmes, but day-to-day administration in Naples effectively assumes it.

degree_class: LM-35 - Italian degree class LM-35 'Ingegneria per l'ambiente e il territorio' (Environmental and Territorial Engineering). This CONFIRMS the degree_class given in the research brief. Stated identically across four official sources: (a) the orientation-portal fact-sheet header, 'Classe di laurea LM-35'; (b) the central unina.it course record, 'Classe di Laurea: LM-35 Ingegneria per l'ambiente e il territorio'; (c) Art. 1 of the Didactic Regulations, "classe LM-35: Ingegneria per l'Ambiente e il Territorio"; (d) the cover of Annex 1 to the Didactic Regulations, in English, 'ENVIRONMENTAL AND TERRITORIAL ENGINEERING - CLASS LM-35 ENVIRONMENTAL AND TERRITORIAL ENGINEERING'. LEGAL BASIS: the class is established by D.M. 270/04 and by the Ministerial Decree of 16 March 2007, which define the qualifying educational objectives and the indispensable training activities. The central record states: "Il Corso di Studio Magistrale in Ingegneria per l'Ambiente e il Territorio e attivato nella Classe delle Lauree Magistrali in Ingegneria per l'Ambiente e il Territorio (classe LM35) sancite dal D.M. 270/04 e dal D.M. 16 marzo 2007." THE MATCHING FIRST-CYCLE CLASS IS L-7 (Ingegneria Civile e Ambientale). This matters because holding an L-7 bachelor is the automatic route through the curricular requirements - see academic_requirements. Teaching area recorded centrally as 'Ingegneria'; School: Scuola Politecnica e delle Scienze di Base; Department: Dipartimento di Ingegneria Civile, Edile e Ambientale. Administratively consistent: engineering class, engineering department, engineering student office at Piazzale Tecchio. Note that the degree class attaches to the DEGREE, not to the curriculum: a graduate of the English Environmental Sustainability curriculum and a graduate of the Italian Dissesto Idrogeologico curriculum receive the identical LM-35 qualification with the identical legal name.
admission_type: OPEN ACCESS WITH A COMPULSORY VERIFICATION OF PREPARATION. The orientation-portal fact sheet labels it 'Accesso: Verifica di preparazione' - NOT 'Libero' and NOT 'numero programmato'. There is NO numerus clausus, NO ranked competitive selection, NO bando/call for applications for the degree itself, NO TOLC and NO application fee. POSITIVE PROOF THAT THERE IS NO SEAT CAP: the University's official index of programmed-number courses for a.y. 2026/2027 (https://www.unina.it/it/didattica/offerta-formativa/corsi-numero-programmato), which is where every Federico II bando for the year is collected, contains no occurrence at all of 'ambiente', of 'LM-35', or of this degree's name, in any of its bachelor, master's or single-cycle sections. THE TWO GATES, both set by Art. 5 of the Didactic Regulations. GATE 1 - SPECIFIC CURRICULAR REQUIREMENTS, verbatim: "A) Specifici requisiti curriculari. Lo studente che intende iscriversi al Corso di Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria per l'Ambiente e il Territorio deve possedere competenze e capacita che vengono ritenute acquisite dallo studente, o che abbia conseguito nella precedente carriera, corsi, maturando un numero minimo di CFU nei Settori Scientifico-Disciplinari riportati all'art. 4 del presente Regolamento Didattico. Lo studente deve inoltre essere in possesso di un livello di conoscenza della Lingua Inglese corrispondente al B2." NOTE THAT B2 ENGLISH IS PART OF GATE 1 HERE - it is a curricular requirement, not an afterthought (see language_requirements). GATE 2 - ADEQUATE PERSONAL PREPARATION, verbatim: "B) Adeguata personale preparazione dello studente. La personale preparazione dello studente viene verificata a mezzo di un colloquio atto a valutare eventuali carenze soprattutto nelle discipline afferenti ai SSD di cui alla precedente lettera A. Coerentemente a quanto stabilito dal Consiglio della Scuola Politecnica e delle Scienze di Base in merito all'ammissione ai corsi di Laurea Magistrale, sono esentati dalla verifica della personale preparazione gli studenti che abbiano conseguito una media negli esami di profitto non inferiore a 24/30." So the second gate is an INTERVIEW, waived outright for anyone with a bachelor examination average of at least 24/30. TWO ENTRY POINTS PER YEAR - AN UNUSUAL AND USEFUL FEATURE OF THIS DEGREE. Art. 5, verbatim: "L'iscrizione e consentita al I o al II semestre di ciascun anno accademico, in funzione della data in cui si e conseguito il titolo di studio che ne consente l'accesso." Enrolment is permitted in EITHER the first OR the second semester of each academic year, depending on when the qualifying degree was obtained. Most Federico II master's degrees publish only a single autumn intake. THREE PRACTICAL ROUTES FOR AN APPLICANT. (1) ITALIAN-QUALIFICATION APPLICANTS: enrol online through SegrePass (https://www.segrepass.unina.it) from 16 July 2026. (2) EU CITIZENS, AND ANYONE (EU or non-EU) LEGALLY RESIDENT IN ITALY OR THE EU, HOLDING A FOREIGN QUALIFICATION: no competitive application and no Universitaly pre-enrolment. Per international.unina.it they "have unrestricted access to university courses if you hold a foreign qualification corresponding to the required Italian qualification. In this case you have to send your academic documents to the Coordinator of the course you wish to enrol in to find out whether you meet the enrolment requirements." For this degree the Coordinator is Prof. Alessandra Cesaro (alessandra.cesaro@unina.it). (3) NON-EU APPLICANTS RESIDING ABROAD: compulsory pre-enrolment on the UNIVERSITALY portal (https://www.universitaly.it/studenti-stranieri) by 15 June 2026, document evaluation by the Coordinator, then a study visa. Because the course is open access, that non-EU pre-enrolment window closes and does not reopen: "After this date pre-enrolment is allowed to the programmes with restricted access only." CRITICAL WARNINGS from international.unina.it: "Be aware that pre-enrolment alone does not grant admission to degree programmes. In order to matriculate you also need to take and pass the verifications of the entry requirements and the admission procedures set for the degree programme of your interest." And: "The University of Naples Federico II does not issue admission letters for obtaining a visa." FOREIGN STUDENTS CANNOT SELF-ENROL ONLINE. The University's 2026/2027 enrolment notice states that foreign students must instead contact the student office by e-mail to matriculate - for this degree, segreing@unina.it. THE CURRICULUM IS CHOSEN AFTER ENROLMENT, NOT AT ADMISSION. There is no separate application, no separate seat allocation and no separate admission route for the English curriculum. A student is admitted to the LM-35 degree and then declares the Environmental Sustainability path in the Study Plan (see application_deadline_eu). A SEPARATE, GENUINELY COMPETITIVE PROCEDURE EXISTS FOR THE DOUBLE DEGREES ONLY. Each double degree is opened by its own rectoral decree, is capped at 3 students, and is awarded by interview - see official_call_url and seats_total. [uncertain] NO PROGRAMME-SPECIFIC ADMISSION PAGE FOR INTERNATIONAL APPLICANTS EXISTS. This degree publishes no annual admission sheet in English, no application form for foreign qualifications, no evaluation timetable and no published decision deadlines. Nothing states who conducts the personal-preparation interview, when it is held, whether it can be sat remotely from abroad, or in which language it is conducted for a candidate applying to the English curriculum. Everything international is handled through the generic University channels plus direct e-mail to the Coordinator.
academic_requirements: BASELINE (Art. 4, verbatim): "L'iscrizione alla Laurea magistrale richiede il possesso della Laurea, ivi compresa quella conseguita secondo l'ordinamento previgente al D.M. 509/1999, o del diploma universitario di durata triennale o di altro titolo conseguito all'estero riconosciuto idoneo." - a bachelor degree (including pre-1999 qualifications), a three-year university diploma, or another qualification obtained abroad and recognised as suitable. TWO ALTERNATIVE CURRICULAR ROUTES. ROUTE A - AUTOMATIC: hold a bachelor degree in Italian class L-7 (Ingegneria Civile e Ambientale). ROUTE B - CREDIT COUNT: satisfy a THREE-LEVEL CFU test, all three levels of which must be met simultaneously. This is one of the most prescriptive curricular tables at Federico II and is reproduced here in full. LEVEL 1 - MINIMUM PER INDIVIDUAL SSD: MAT/05 (MATH-03/A, Analisi Matematica) = min 12 CFU; MAT/07 (MATH-04/A, Fisica Matematica) = min 6; MAT/03 (MATH-02/B), MAT/06 (MATH-03/B), MAT/08 (MATH-05/A), MAT/09 (MATH-06/A), SECS-S/02 (STAT-01/A), ING-INF/05 (IINF-05/A) = min 6; FIS/01 (PHYS-03/A), CHIM/07 (CHEM-06/A), ING-IND/22 (IMAT-01/A) = min 12; ICAR/01 (CEAR-01/A, Idraulica) = min 6; ICAR/07 (CEAR-05/A, Geotecnica) = min 6; ICAR/04 (CEAR-03/A), ICAR/05 (CEAR-03/B) = min 6; ICAR/08 (CEAR-06/A, Scienza delle Costruzioni) = min 6. LEVEL 2 - MINIMUM PER GROUP OF SSDs: MAT/05, MAT/07, MAT/03, MAT/06, MAT/08, MAT/09, SECS-S/02, ING-INF/05 = min 30 CFU; ICAR/01, ICAR/02 = min 12; ICAR/07, GEO/05 (GEOS-03/B) = min 6; ICAR/04, ICAR/05, ICAR/20 (CEAR-12/A) = min 6; ICAR/08, ICAR/09 (CEAR-07/A) = min 12; ICAR/03 (CEAR-02/A), ING-IND/24 (ICHI-01/B), ING-IND/25 (ICHI-02/A), ING-IND/27 (ICHI-02/B) = min 6. LEVEL 3 - MINIMUM PER SUBJECT AREA: the whole basic-science block (MAT/05, MAT/07, MAT/03, MAT/06, MAT/08, MAT/09, SECS-S/02, ING-INF/05, FIS/01, CHIM/07, ING-IND/22) = MIN 45 CFU; the whole civil-environmental engineering block (ICAR/01, ICAR/02, ICAR/07, GEO/05, ICAR/04, ICAR/05, ICAR/20, ICAR/08, ICAR/09, ICAR/03, ING-IND/24, ING-IND/25, ING-IND/27) = MIN 51 CFU. IN PLAIN TERMS, ROUTE B DEMANDS AT LEAST 96 CFU OF SPECIFIED CONTENT (45 + 51) inside a 180-CFU bachelor, spread across mathematics, physics, chemistry, materials, informatics, hydraulics, geotechnics, surveying/GIS, structural mechanics, sanitary-environmental engineering and chemical plant engineering. This is a CIVIL-AND-ENVIRONMENTAL profile. An applicant with a general environmental-science, chemistry, geology or mechanical background will very likely fail Level 1 on Idraulica (ICAR/01, 6 CFU), Geotecnica (ICAR/07, 6 CFU) or Scienza delle Costruzioni (ICAR/08, 6 CFU) - these three are the classic failure points, because they are civil-engineering staples that do not appear in most non-civil degrees. AND B2 ENGLISH IS PART OF THE SAME ARTICLE. Art. 4 closes with: "E richiesta inoltre una conoscenza della lingua inglese di livello B2." See language_requirements. WHO CHECKS, AND WHAT HAPPENS IF YOU FALL SHORT. The Commissione di Coordinamento Didattico (CCD, Teaching Coordination Committee) governs admission criteria (Art. 5.1: "La Commissione di Coordinamento Didattico del corso di norma disciplina i criteri di ammissione e l'eventuale programmazione delle iscrizioni, fatte salve differenti disposizioni di legge"). Art. 15 of the Regulations sets criteria for enrolment in single course units (corsi singoli) activated within the University - the standard Federico II remedy for a candidate who is short of specific SSD credits and must acquire them before matriculating (https://www.unina.it/-/5601348-iscrizione-ai-corsi-singoli). [uncertain] THREE SUBSTANTIAL GAPS, ALL OF THEM MATERIAL TO A FOREIGN APPLICANT. (1) UNLIKE SEVERAL SISTER DEGREES, THIS REGULATION PUBLISHES NO EQUIVALENCE CLAUSE. Nothing in Arts. 4-5 empowers the CCD to recognise credits from different SSDs on the basis of course content, and nothing provides an 'alignment path' for a partially-qualified candidate. Whether the CCD nonetheless exercises such discretion in practice is not published. (2) HOW A FOREIGN DEGREE IS MAPPED ONTO ITALIAN SSD CODES IS NOWHERE STATED - not how non-Italian ECTS are matched to SSDs, not whether a 180-ECTS three-year bachelor is required (four-year bachelors are common outside the EU), not what syllabus evidence is accepted, not how long the evaluation takes, and not whether a written eligibility decision is issued before the visa stage. The only stated channel is to e-mail the transcript and syllabi to the Coordinator, and this should be done MONTHS before the 15 June Universitaly deadline. (3) THE CENTRAL UNINA.IT RECORD PUBLISHES A DIFFERENT AND STALER VERSION OF THE SAME TABLE: it adds a requirement 'INF/07 = min 9' at Level 1 that does NOT appear in the current Regulations, and it omits the new post-reform SSD codes (CEAR-xx, MATH-xx, ICHI-xx) that the Regulations give alongside the legacy codes. The Didactic Regulations are the binding text; treat the central record as out of date. The central record additionally carries a generic requirement that graduates "devono essere in grado di utilizzare almeno una lingua dell'Unione Europea diversa dall'italiano" - be able to use at least one EU language other than Italian - which is phrased for Italian students and is not reconciled anywhere with the B2 English rule.
entry_exam_or_test: THERE IS NO WRITTEN ENTRANCE EXAMINATION AND NO COMPETITIVE TEST. There is no TOLC, no CISIA test, no GRE/GMAT, no portfolio, and no written admission paper of any kind for this degree. What exists is an INTERVIEW, and it is waived for most candidates. THE RULE, verbatim from Art. 5: "La personale preparazione dello studente viene verificata a mezzo di un colloquio atto a valutare eventuali carenze soprattutto nelle discipline afferenti ai SSD di cui alla precedente lettera A." - the student's personal preparation is verified BY MEANS OF AN INTERVIEW, designed to assess any shortcomings above all in the disciplines belonging to the scientific-disciplinary sectors listed in the curricular-requirements table. So the interview is diagnostic and subject-specific, not a general motivation interview. THE AUTOMATIC EXEMPTION, verbatim from the same article: "Coerentemente a quanto stabilito dal Consiglio della Scuola Politecnica e delle Scienze di Base in merito all'ammissione ai corsi di Laurea Magistrale, sono esentati dalla verifica della personale preparazione gli studenti che abbiano conseguito una media negli esami di profitto non inferiore a 24/30." - students who achieved an examination average of NOT LESS THAN 24/30 are EXEMPT from the personal-preparation check altogether. 24/30 is roughly 80% on the Italian scale; broadly comparable to a UK 2:1, a US GPA of about 3.0-3.2, or the ECTS C/B boundary - but no official conversion table is published for this course. Note that, unlike the equivalent rule at some sister degrees, THIS text does not say the average is CFU-weighted; it says simply 'una media negli esami di profitto'. SO THE SEQUENCE IS: hold the curricular requirements and a B2 English certificate; if your bachelor average is at least 24/30 you are through with no interview; if it is below 24/30 you sit the diagnostic interview. THERE IS A SECOND, SEPARATE TEST - THE ENGLISH PLACEMENT TEST - BUT IT IS TAKEN AFTER ENROLMENT, NOT BEFORE. The Department publishes it as the 'Calendario del Placement Test di Inglese - Corsi LM Ingegneria' (https://www.dicea.unina.it/calendario-del-placement-test-di-inglese-corsi-lm-ingegneria/), covering eleven engineering master's degrees including 'Ingegneria per l'ambiente e il territorio (classe LM-35)'. Verbatim: "Il Placement Test ha lo scopo di accertare le competenze linguistiche richieste dal Regolamento Didattico del Corso di Studio per gli studenti iscritti al primo anno dei Corsi di Laurea Magistrale. Il test e svolto interamente online. Per gli studenti che non superano il test, a partire dal mese di giugno sara erogato un corso della durata di 30 ore da parte del Centro Linguistico di Ateneo." - the Placement Test verifies the language competences required by the Didactic Regulations, for students ENROLLED IN THE FIRST YEAR; it is run entirely online; students who do not pass are given a 30-hour course by the University Language Centre from June onwards. Booking is at https://esol.unina.it/ using the Italian tax code and the unina e-mail password; the exam is named 'Placement test', subject 'Lingua inglese', delivered over Microsoft Teams. A 2026 edition was advertised at the CLA language laboratory, Via Mezzocannone 8, 4th floor, on 6 March 2026 at 10:00, with registration from 20 February to 1 March 2026 and a maximum of 50 places. A THIRD, GENUINELY COMPETITIVE SELECTION EXISTS - BUT ONLY FOR THE DOUBLE DEGREES. Art. 4 of the Sofia double-degree call: "L'ammissione avverra sulla base di una selezione basata su di un colloquio per verificare che le conoscenze di base dei potenziali studenti soddisfino i requisiti dei due Corsi di Studio, e per verificare la motivazione dei potenziali studenti per partecipare al programma. In caso di parita tra due o piu candidati avra precedenza in graduatoria il candidato piu giovane di eta." - selection by interview testing both subject knowledge against the two programmes' requirements and motivation; ties are broken in favour of the YOUNGER candidate. The examining board named in the Sofia call was Prof. Massimiliano Fabbricino (then Coordinator), Prof. Francesca Pagliara (responsible for implementing the Double Degree programme) and Prof. Salvatore Manfreda (Internationalisation Commission). [uncertain] THE INTERVIEW'S PRACTICAL DETAILS ARE ENTIRELY UNPUBLISHED, AND FOR AN OVERSEAS APPLICANT THIS IS THE BIGGEST OPERATIONAL UNKNOWN IN THE WHOLE ADMISSION PROCESS. Nothing states who sits on the interview panel, when interviews are held, how to book one, whether they can be conducted remotely from abroad, how long the outcome takes, whether the outcome is issued in writing, or - critically for this record - WHETHER THE INTERVIEW IS CONDUCTED IN ITALIAN OR IN ENGLISH for a candidate applying to the English-taught curriculum. Nor is it stated how the 24/30 exemption is applied to a foreign transcript that has no Italian 30-point average: whether the CCD converts foreign grades, treats the average as unavailable and therefore requires the interview, or waives it. An applicant below 24/30, or with a non-Italian grading scale, should raise this explicitly with Prof. Cesaro well before the 15 June Universitaly deadline.
seats_total: NO SEAT LIMIT IS SET FOR THE DEGREE - it is open access with a verification of preparation, so no total number of places exists to be published, and none is. EVIDENCE: (1) the orientation-portal fact sheet records the admission mode as 'Accesso: Verifica di preparazione', not 'numero programmato'; (2) the University's official 2026/2027 index of programmed-number courses (https://www.unina.it/it/didattica/offerta-formativa/corsi-numero-programmato) contains no occurrence of this degree, of 'LM-35' or of 'ambiente' anywhere in its bachelor, master's or single-cycle sections; (3) no bando, no ranking (graduatoria), no application fee and no competitive application deadline is published for the degree anywhere on unina.it; (4) Art. 5.1 of the Didactic Regulations mentions "l'eventuale programmazione delle iscrizioni" - the possible future capping of enrolments - only as a power the CCD could exercise, footnoting Law 264/1999. It has not been exercised. PRACTICAL MEANING: anyone who satisfies the curricular requirements, holds B2 English and clears the personal-preparation gate can enrol; there is no competition against other candidates, and no seat is 'won'. THE ONLY PUBLISHED NUMERICAL CAPS IN THIS ENTIRE RECORD BELONG TO THE DOUBLE DEGREES, AND THEY ARE VERY SMALL. Each double-degree call states, verbatim: "Alla frequenza del percorso sono ammessi 3 iscritti" - 3 students are admitted to the pathway. That figure of 3 appears in the Sofia (UACEG Bulgaria) call for a.y. 2025/26 and again in the Kyungpook (Daegu, South Korea) call for a.y. 2026/27. The programme website states the same in both languages: "E' possibile, ad un numero massimo di 3 allievi... partecipare al programma" / "A maximum of 3 students enrolled at the University on Naples Federico II may apply". So: unlimited places on the degree, 3 places per partner on each double degree. [uncertain] NO COHORT SIZE IS PUBLISHED FOR THE PROGRAMME OR FOR THE ENGLISH CURRICULUM. Neither the orientation portal, nor the programme site, nor the Didactic Regulations, nor the Manifesto state how many students enrol per year in the LM-35 degree as a whole, how many choose the Environmental Sustainability path, or whether that path is activated only above a minimum cohort. This last point is a genuine risk: because the curriculum is selected after enrolment via the Study Plan and no minimum cohort is published anywhere, there is no documentary guarantee that the English curriculum runs in any given year. The programme does publish annual monitoring reports (Scheda di Monitoraggio Annuale, e.g. https://www.iat.unina.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/SMA_2025_IAT_LM_emendata.pdf) and the Scheda Unica Annuale (https://www.iat.unina.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/SUA-CdS-LM-IAT-2025.pdf) under its quality-assurance page, which carry enrolment statistics for the degree, but these are quality-assurance documents that do not break the figures down by curriculum. If cohort size matters to the decision, ask Prof. Cesaro directly.
non_eu_reserved_seats: NO RESERVED NON-EU QUOTA IS PUBLISHED, AND NONE IS EXPECTED, BECAUSE THE DEGREE IS OPEN ACCESS. Reserved non-EU contingents at Federico II are declared inside the bando of each numero-programmato course; this degree publishes no bando at all, so there is no quota table, no sub-quota and no ranking for non-EU applicants. WHAT REPLACES THE QUOTA for a non-EU applicant residing abroad: compulsory pre-enrolment on the Universitaly portal by 15 June 2026, an individual document evaluation by the Programme Coordinator, then a study visa - all of which are capacity-unconstrained on the University side. THE MIRROR-IMAGE RULE MATTERS TOO, and is stated on international.unina.it: non-European candidates who are regularly residing in Italy or in a European Union country "have unrestricted access to university courses if you hold a foreign qualification corresponding to the required Italian qualification" - i.e. a non-EU citizen ALREADY legally resident in Italy or the EU bypasses Universitaly entirely and goes straight to the Coordinator, on the same footing as an EU citizen. The distinction that matters at Federico II is RESIDENCE, not citizenship. NOTE ALSO that non-EU citizens are the fee-privileged group at this University, not the disadvantaged one: they are totally exempt from the tuition contribution (see tuition_or_fees_link). [uncertain] THE ABSENCE OF A PUBLISHED QUOTA IS INFERRED, NOT STATED. No unina.it page says in words 'there is no reserved quota for non-EU students on this degree'; the conclusion rests on the degree's absence from the 2026/2027 numero-programmato index and on the general open-access rule. Federico II does file per-course non-EU availability figures with the Universitaly portal each year, and that filing was not verifiable from unina.it sources. A non-EU applicant should confirm availability with the Coordinator before the June deadline. Note separately that the double-degree calls, which DO carry a cap of 3, are silent on citizenship and appear to be aimed at students already enrolled at Federico II or at the partner university, so they are not an entry route for a new international applicant.
language_requirements: B2 ENGLISH IS A HARD ADMISSION REQUIREMENT FOR THIS DEGREE, CERTIFIED BY DOCUMENT. This is stated three times over and is unambiguous - and it sets this degree apart from several other Federico II engineering master's degrees, where B2 is only a graduation requirement. (1) Art. 4 of the Didactic Regulations, closing the curricular-requirements article: "E richiesta inoltre una conoscenza della lingua inglese di livello B2." (A knowledge of the English language at B2 level is also required.) (2) Art. 5, inside gate A: "Lo studente deve inoltre essere in possesso di un livello di conoscenza della Lingua Inglese corrispondente al B2." (3) The central unina.it course record repeats it verbatim under 'Conoscenze richieste per l'accesso': "E' richiesta inoltre una conoscenza della lingua Inglese di livello B2." So B2 English is a CURRICULAR REQUIREMENT, on the same legal footing as the CFU table - not a soft preference. HOW IT IS PROVED. Art. 5, verbatim: "La conoscenza della lingua inglese e accertata attraverso la presentazione di attestato rilasciato da un organismo competente." - knowledge of English is verified through the presentation of a certificate issued by a competent body. No list of accepted certificates and no minimum IELTS/TOEFL score is published for this degree; 'organismo competente' is left undefined. THE ESCAPE HATCH - CONDITIONAL ENROLMENT. The orientation portal adds a concession that the Regulations themselves do not spell out, verbatim: "E' richiesta inoltre una conoscenza della lingua Inglese di livello B2. L'assenza di tale requisito consente tuttavia l'iscrizione sub-condizione, a patto che venga conseguito un certificato attestante il grado di conoscenza della lingua inglese entro il primo semestre del secondo anno di corso." - the absence of this requirement nevertheless allows CONDITIONAL enrolment ('sub-condizione'), provided that a certificate attesting the level of English is obtained BY THE FIRST SEMESTER OF THE SECOND YEAR. In practice this gives an applicant who is short of a certificate roughly 12-18 months from matriculation to produce one. THE IN-HOUSE ROUTE TO THE CERTIFICATE. The Department runs an English Placement Test for first-year master's students of eleven engineering degrees, this one included, expressly to verify the language competence the Didactic Regulations demand. Registration at https://esol.unina.it/ ; delivered online via Microsoft Teams; students who fail are given a 30-hour course by the Centro Linguistico di Ateneo (CLA) from June. Recent in-person editions were held at the CLA language laboratory, Via Mezzocannone 8, 4th floor. The programme site's own notice is headed 'Apertura iscrizioni al placement test lingua inglese requisito B2 Lauree Magistrali' - registration opening for the English placement test, B2 requirement, master's degrees - which confirms the test is the B2 route for this degree. A 2026 sitting was advertised for 6 March 2026 at 10:00, registration 20 February to 1 March 2026, maximum 50 places. NO ITALIAN LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT FOR THE ENGLISH CURRICULUM. International.unina.it: "If you choose a three-year degree course, magistral degree course or single-cycle magistral degree course in ITALIAN, a B2 level Italian language proficiency is required" (accepted CLIQ-system certificates: Universita per Stranieri di Perugia, Universita per Stranieri di Siena, Roma Tre, Societa Dante Alighieri, Universita per Stranieri Dante Alighieri di Reggio Calabria), whereas "If you choose a three-year, five-year or single-cycle degree course in ENGLISH, level B2 Italian language proficiency is not required." It adds a practical note for the visa: "Remember that an international certificate attesting to the level of English language skills (IELTS, TOEFL, Cambridge, etc.) is useful for the issue of the visa by the diplomatic/consular Representation." BOTTOM LINE FOR AN INTERNATIONAL APPLICANT: bring a B2-or-better English certificate. Here, unlike at some sister degrees, it is genuinely required for admission, it is separately useful at the visa interview, and without it you can only enrol conditionally. [uncertain] FOUR GAPS. (1) NO LIST OF ACCEPTED CERTIFICATES AND NO SCORE THRESHOLDS are published - neither the Regulations, nor the orientation portal, nor the programme site name IELTS, TOEFL, Cambridge or any minimum band for this degree, and 'organismo competente' is undefined. (2) THE CONDITIONAL-ENROLMENT CONCESSION APPEARS ONLY ON THE ORIENTATION PORTAL, not in the binding Didactic Regulations, which state the B2 requirement flatly; the two are not reconciled anywhere, and it is unclear whether the student office applies the concession to holders of foreign qualifications. (3) WHETHER A DEGREE PREVIOUSLY TAUGHT IN ENGLISH WAIVES THE CERTIFICATE IS NOT STATED - this waiver is explicit at several sister degrees but absent here, so a graduate of an English-medium university abroad has no published exemption and should ask. (4) NOTHING STATES A HIGHER ENGLISH BAR FOR THE ENGLISH CURRICULUM than for the three Italian ones - the same B2 applies to all four, and no source explains how a student admitted with conditional (i.e. unproven) English is expected to follow an exclusively English curriculum from day one. Ask Prof. Cesaro (alessandra.cesaro@unina.it).
application_deadline_eu: THERE IS NO COMPETITIVE APPLICATION DEADLINE FOR EU/EU-TREATED APPLICANTS, BECAUSE THERE IS NO SELECTION. What exists are (a) the University's enrolment (immatricolazione) window, (b) the Study Plan deadline at which the English curriculum is actually chosen, and (c) the separate double-degree call deadlines. ENROLMENT WINDOW FOR a.y. 2026/2027 (binding source: 'Guida all'iscrizione Anno accademico 2026-27', section 'Date importanti da ricordare'). 16 JULY 2026 - "Inizio periodo ordinario immatricolazione" (ordinary matriculation period opens) and "Inizio periodo ordinario iscrizione agli anni successivi". 1 SEPTEMBER 2026 - ordinary period opens for transfers and course changes. 2 NOVEMBRE 2026 - "Scadenza periodo ordinario immatricolazione e iscrizione agli anni successivi" (ordinary matriculation deadline), also the deadline for direct INPS retrieval of ISEEU income data and for transfers. 3 NOVEMBER 2026 - extraordinary period opens. 15 JANUARY 2027 - last day to matriculate late, with a EUR 50 surcharge; from 16 January 2027 the surcharge rises to EUR 110. CONFLICTING DATE ON THE UNIVERSITY'S OWN PAGES - see uncertainty_notes: the programme's orientation-portal page states "L'immatricolazione e l'iscrizione agli anni successivi hanno luogo, di norma, dal 1 settembre al 31 ottobre di ogni anno" (normally from 1 September to 31 October each year), whereas the binding Guida gives a window opening on 16 July and closing on 2 November 2026. Treat 31 October 2026 as the safe date. THIS DEGREE HAS TWO ENTRY POINTS PER YEAR, WHICH SOFTENS ALL OF THE ABOVE. Art. 5 of the Didactic Regulations: "L'iscrizione e consentita al I o al II semestre di ciascun anno accademico, in funzione della data in cui si e conseguito il titolo di studio che ne consente l'accesso." - enrolment is permitted in the first OR the second semester of each academic year, depending on when the qualifying degree was obtained. A candidate graduating in, say, the European spring is therefore not automatically pushed to the following September. NOTE that the second-semester entry point is stated in the Regulations but is NOT given its own published date anywhere. THE STUDY-PLAN DEADLINE - THE DATE THAT ACTUALLY SELECTS THE ENGLISH CURRICULUM. Because the curriculum is chosen after enrolment, the operative act is the submission of the Study Plan (Piano di Studio). The orientation portal states: "Ogni anno gli studenti possono presentare il Piano di Studio per il successivo anno accademico. Il Piano di Studio puo essere presentato anche prima dell'iscrizione all'anno accademico successivo e prima del versamento del bollettino di iscrizione. I Piani di Studio sono esaminati e approvati dalla Commissione di Coordinamento Didattico entro 45 giorni dalla data di ricezione. In mancanza di delibera entro quel termine, essi sono considerati approvati." - Study Plans are examined and approved by the CCD WITHIN 45 DAYS of receipt, and are deemed approved by silence if no decision is taken in that time. The Study Plan may be submitted before enrolling for the following year and before paying. The University-wide deadline for master's study-plan matters in the 2026/27 cycle is 31 March 2027 per the Guida. EU CITIZENS AND EU-RESIDENT APPLICANTS WITH A FOREIGN QUALIFICATION have no portal deadline at all - they send documents to the Coordinator (alessandra.cesaro@unina.it) whenever they are ready, but must leave enough time for the eligibility assessment and, if the bachelor average is below 24/30, for the personal-preparation interview, before the enrolment window closes. Holders of foreign qualifications cannot use SegrePass and must enrol by e-mailing the Engineering student office at segreing@unina.it. DOUBLE-DEGREE DEADLINES, which are real, competitive and early: the Kyungpook call for a.y. 2026/27 required applications "fino al 30 novembre 2025" with admitted candidates obliged to matriculate "entro il 31 dicembre 2025" on pain of forfeiture; the Sofia call for a.y. 2025/26 used the identical pattern one year earlier (30 November 2024 / 31 December 2024). Applications go on plain paper, hand-signed, to the Coordinator at DICEA, Via Claudio 21, 80125 Napoli. So the double-degree window for a given academic year closes roughly TEN MONTHS BEFORE that year starts. [uncertain] NO PROGRAMME-LEVEL EVALUATION CALENDAR EXISTS. There is no published date by which the Coordinator must respond to a document submission, no stated evaluation turnaround, no interview calendar and no formal offer letter. The 45-day rule applies to Study Plans, not to admission assessments. Dates for a.y. 2027/2028 were not published as of 30 August 2026, although a programme news item of 3 July 2026 announced that the 2027/2028 Sofia and Kyungpook double-degree calls were about to be published.
application_deadline_non_eu: FOR NON-EU CANDIDATES RESIDING ABROAD, TWO HARD UNIVERSITY-LEVEL DEADLINES GOVERN, AND BOTH ARE SET CENTRALLY, NOT BY THE PROGRAMME. (1) 15 JUNE 2026 - UNIVERSITALY PRE-ENROLMENT. Verbatim from international.unina.it: "JUNE - 15 - 2026 - Pre-enrolment application deadline to University of Naples Federico II. After this date no programme changes are permitted. After this date pre-enrolment is allowed to the programmes with restricted access only." Because THIS degree is OPEN access, that last sentence is decisive: once 15 June has passed, the window for this course does not reopen for the cycle. Pre-enrolment is made on https://www.universitaly.it/studenti-stranieri . (2) 30 NOVEMBER 2026 - VISA APPLICATION. Verbatim: "NOVEMBER - 30 - 2026 - Deadline for submitting the Visa Application at Italian Embassies/Consulates." TWO WARNINGS THE UNIVERSITY PRINTS ITSELF, both of which apply in full to this degree. "Be aware that pre-enrolment alone does not grant admission to degree programmes. In order to matriculate you also need to take and pass the verifications of the entry requirements and the admission procedures set for the degree programme of your interest." And: "Important! The University of Naples Federico II does not issue admission letters for obtaining a visa." For this programme the 'verifications' are the curricular CFU table, the B2 English certificate and - below 24/30 - the personal-preparation interview. THEN THE ORDINARY ENROLMENT WINDOW STILL APPLIES on arrival: 16 July 2026 to 2 November 2026 (ordinary), late until 15 January 2027 with a EUR 50 surcharge and thereafter EUR 110. Foreign students cannot matriculate through SegrePass and must contact the Engineering student office by e-mail (segreing@unina.it). THE CRITICAL EXCEPTION - MANY 'NON-EU' APPLICANTS ARE NOT SUBJECT TO ANY OF THIS. Per international.unina.it, non-EU citizens who are regularly residing in Italy or in a European Union country "have unrestricted access to university courses if you hold a foreign qualification corresponding to the required Italian qualification. In this case you have to send your academic documents to the Coordinator of the course you wish to enrol in." They skip Universitaly, skip the 15 June deadline and skip the visa step entirely. The dividing line is residence, not passport. STATUS AS OF THE RESEARCH DATE (30 AUGUST 2026): THE NON-EU DEADLINE FOR THE CURRENT CYCLE HAS PASSED. 15 June 2026 was the pre-enrolment deadline for a.y. 2026/2027 and, the course being open access, it did not reopen. A non-EU applicant residing abroad who reads this record is therefore targeting a.y. 2027/2028, whose deadlines had not been published as of 30 August 2026 but which, on the pattern of the last several years, will fall in mid-June 2027 for pre-enrolment and end-November 2027 for the visa. [uncertain] THREE GAPS. (1) NO PROGRAMME-SPECIFIC NON-EU PROCEDURE OR CALENDAR EXISTS - this degree publishes nothing of its own for non-EU applicants: no evaluation timetable, no document checklist, no service standard for how quickly Federico II validates a Universitaly pre-enrolment, and no offer-letter process. Without validation the Embassy will not issue the visa, and no published deadline binds the University to validate in time. (2) THE SEQUENCING IS UNRESOLVED FOR ANY CANDIDATE BELOW 24/30: the personal-preparation interview has no published dates at all, so it cannot be timed against the 15 June pre-enrolment deadline, and nothing states whether it can be sat remotely from abroad. (3) THE SECOND-SEMESTER ENTRY POINT permitted by Art. 5 has no published non-EU pathway - Universitaly pre-enrolment and visa issuance are built around a single autumn intake, and nothing explains how a non-EU candidate would use the second-semester option.
required_documents: NO PROGRAMME-SPECIFIC DOCUMENT CHECKLIST IS PUBLISHED FOR THIS DEGREE. What follows is the University-level list plus the programme-specific evidence implied by the admission rules. A. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED FOR ENROLMENT (international.unina.it, 'Documents required for enrolment', verbatim): "Copy of passport; Application form; 1 passport photo; Tax code; Residence permit (proof of having applied for it); Declaration of value issued by the Italian Embassy in the country where the degree was obtained or certificate of validity issued by ENIC-NARIC centres." Notes: the 'tax code' is the Italian codice fiscale; the 'Declaration of Value' (Dichiarazione di Valore) is the item that takes longest to obtain and should be started months ahead; an ENIC-NARIC statement of comparability (e.g. CIMEA) is accepted as an alternative. B. EVIDENCE THE PROGRAMME ITSELF NEEDS, in order to clear the two admission gates. (i) The DEGREE CERTIFICATE plus a FULL ACADEMIC TRANSCRIPT showing every examination with its credit value and mark - because Art. 4 is decided on a credit-by-credit reading against a three-level SSD table, and because the 24/30 exemption is computed from the examination average. (ii) COURSE SYLLABI / programme descriptions - because a foreign transcript carries no Italian SSD codes, so the Coordination Committee must map content onto ICAR/01, ICAR/07, ICAR/08, MAT/05 and the rest by reading what was actually taught. (iii) A B2 ENGLISH CERTIFICATE 'issued by a competent body' (Art. 5) - this is a hard curricular requirement here, not an optional extra. (iv) Passport/identity document. Send these by e-mail to the Coordinator, Prof. Alessandra Cesaro (alessandra.cesaro@unina.it), well before the enrolment window. C. FOR NON-EU APPLICANTS RESIDING ABROAD, additionally: the UNIVERSITALY pre-enrolment application (https://www.universitaly.it/studenti-stranieri) by 15 June, followed by the study-visa application at the Italian Embassy or Consulate by 30 November. Remember the University's own warning that it does not issue admission letters for visa purposes. D. FOR THE DOUBLE-DEGREE CALLS ONLY, a precise and unusually old-fashioned checklist is published, verbatim from Art. 6 of the calls: an application on plain paper ('domanda di ammissione in carta semplice'), HAND-SIGNED by the candidate ('firmata di proprio pugno'), stating "Cognome e Nome, data e luogo di nascita, cittadinanza, residenza e recapito per eventuali comunicazioni relative al concorso, numero di telefono (fisso e/o mobile), eventuale indirizzo di posta elettronica e codice fiscale" and "La denominazione della Laurea posseduta e dell'Universita che l'ha rilasciata, con indicazione del voto finale, della data di conseguimento e del titolo della tesi di laurea"; with three attachments - "1) l'autocertificazione relativa alla laurea conseguita con voto, data di conseguimento della stessa; 2) certificato degli esami sostenuti con rispettivi voti; 3) fotocopia fronte retro di valido documento di identita." The application is addressed to the Programme Coordinator and delivered to the Dipartimento di Ingegneria Civile Edile ed Ambientale, Via Claudio 21, 80125 Napoli; postal applications are accepted only if they ARRIVE by the deadline, even if posted earlier ("Le domande inviate per posta saranno accettate solo se pervenute entro il giorno..."). E. FOR FEE PURPOSES, an ISEEU income attestation if you wish to be placed in a lower regional-tax band; without it you are placed in the top band. Households resident abroad are assigned the middle band by rule. [uncertain] SIGNIFICANT GAPS. No unina.it page states, for this degree: whether documents must be legalised or apostilled beyond the Declaration of Value; whether certified translations into Italian are required and by whom; whether digital or scanned copies are accepted at the assessment stage; what format the syllabi must take; which English certificates count and at what scores; or whether any programme-specific application form exists (no such form was found - the process is an unstructured e-mail to the Coordinator). The double-degree checklist above is the ONLY explicit, itemised document list this programme publishes, and it applies to a procedure open to 3 students a year, not to ordinary admission.
tuition_or_fees_link: PRIMARY LINKS. Student guides and the binding fee rules: https://www.unina.it/didattica/sportello-studenti/guide-dello-studente (the orientation portal directs applicants here by name for "una specifica Guida alla iscrizione e al pagamento delle tasse"). Registration and fees, English: https://www.unina.it/en/didattica/iscrizioni-e-tasse . OFFICIAL FEE SIMULATOR, linked from page 1 of the Guida itself: http://calcolatrice.unina.it ("Per una simulazione degli importi da pagare vedi: http://calcolatrice.unina.it"). SUMMARY - AND THE HEADLINE IS THAT NON-EU CITIZENS PAY LESS THAN EVERYONE ELSE. Verbatim from the 'Guida all'iscrizione 2026-27': "e. stranieri (cittadinanza in Paesi extra UE): sono esonerati totalmente dal pagamento del contributo di iscrizione; devono versare solo la tassa regionale per il diritto allo studio secondo le disposizioni di cui al punto 1 sopra e l'imposta di bollo, entro il termine ordinario di scadenza per il versamento della I rata" - non-EU citizens are TOTALLY EXEMPT from the tuition contribution and pay only the regional right-to-study tax and the stamp duty. And: "f. europei (cittadinanza in altri Paesi UE): sono tenuti solo al versamento di un contributo fisso pari a 200 EUR per l'iscrizione, se l'importo del contributo dovuto sia pari o superiore a 200 EUR. Se inferiore, possono effettuare l'iscrizione nella modalita ordinaria" - citizens of other EU countries pay a FLAT 200 EUR contribution, provided the amount otherwise due is 200 EUR or more. THE REGIONAL RIGHT-TO-STUDY TAX, in three ISEEU bands (Guida 2026-27, D.M. n. 176 of 24 February 2026), verbatim: "130,00 euro per coloro che presentano un valore ISEEU inferiore o pari a 25.500,00 euro e per gli studenti appartenenti ai Paesi particolarmente poveri"; "151,00 euro per coloro che presentano un valore ISEEU compreso tra 25.500,01 euro e 51.000,00 euro E PER GLI STUDENTI CON NUCLEO FAMILIARE RESIDENTE ALL'ESTERO"; "173,00 euro per coloro che presentano un valore ISEEU superiore a 51.000,00 euro e per coloro che non presentano attestazione ISEEU." THE MIDDLE BAND, 151 EUR, IS THE ONE ASSIGNED BY RULE TO STUDENTS WHOSE HOUSEHOLD RESIDES ABROAD - which is most international students. Students from 'particularly poor countries' under art. 13(5) DPCM 9 April 2001 get the 130 EUR band. Stamp duty is 16 EUR. SO THE REALISTIC ANNUAL COST for an incoming international student on this degree is: NON-EU citizen resident abroad = 151 EUR regional tax + 16 EUR stamp = about 167 EUR per year, with the tuition contribution waived entirely. EU citizen resident abroad = 200 EUR contribution + 151 EUR + 16 EUR = about 367 EUR per year. These are among the lowest published fees in the Italian public system. INSTALMENTS for a.y. 2026/27: the first instalment (with the contribution, regional tax and stamp duty) by 2 NOVEMBER 2026; the second instalment, 20% of the amount, by 1 MARCH 2027; the third instalment, 20%, by 30 APRIL 2027. Those entitled to exemptions must act on the portal by 2 November 2026, and supporting documentation for band placement must reach the University by 7 January 2027 - "per non essere collocati nell'ultima fascia di pagamento della tassa regionale" (so as not to be placed in the top regional-tax band). Late matriculation carries a EUR 50 surcharge to 15 January 2027 and EUR 110 from 16 January 2027. PROGRAMME-SPECIFIC FINANCIAL SUPPORT. For the double degrees, Art. 5 of the calls states: "L'Universita degli Studi di Napoli Federico II contribuira alla copertura delle spese solo degli studenti della Federico II partecipanti, con un importo pari alla borsa Erasmus" - Federico II contributes to costs only for its OWN participating students, at an amount equal to an Erasmus grant. The 3 July 2026 news item repeats that scholarships are available again: "Anche quest'anno, gli allievi interessati avranno la possibilita di accedere a borse di studio a supporto di queste esperienze formative." [uncertain] TWO DISCREPANCIES AND ONE GAP. (1) international.unina.it publishes a FLAT regional tax of 140 EUR per year for both EU and non-EU students, which contradicts the binding Guida's three bands of 130/151/173 EUR. Use the Guida; the 140 EUR figure appears to be a stale simplification. (2) NO FEE PAGE OF ITS OWN is published by this degree or by DICEA - neither the orientation portal page nor iat.unina.it carries a fees section, so everything above is University-level. (3) NO SCHOLARSHIP INFORMATION SPECIFIC TO THIS DEGREE was found beyond the double-degree Erasmus-equivalent grants; the regional right-to-study body (ADISURC) and the University's own scholarship calls are the general channels, and they were outside the unina.it-only scope of this brief.

official_call_url: THERE IS NO CALL, NO BANDO AND NO RECTORAL DECREE FOR ADMISSION TO THIS DEGREE - and that absence is itself the finding. Admission is open access with a verification of preparation, so the University publishes no competitive announcement, no ranking and no application form for it. The degree does not appear anywhere on the University's 2026/2027 index of programmed-number courses (https://www.unina.it/it/didattica/offerta-formativa/corsi-numero-programmato), which is where every Federico II bando for a.y. 2026/27 is collected. THE DOCUMENTS THAT PLAY THE ROLE OF A CALL, in descending order of legal weight: (1) the DIDACTIC REGULATIONS of the degree programme, which set the admission criteria in Arts. 4 and 5 - https://www.iat.unina.it/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Regolamento_LM_IAT_25-26.pdf (Italian, with annexes), plus the official English annex https://www.iat.unina.it/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Annex_1_EN_LM_IAT_25-26.pdf ; (2) the MANIFESTO DEGLI STUDI for a.y. 2026/2027, https://www.iat.unina.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Manifesto_LM_IAT_26_27.pdf , which fixes the curriculum tables and semester placement; (3) the 2026/2027 STUDY PLAN annex, https://www.orientamento.unina.it/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/LM_IAT_All_1_1_PianoStudi_ITA.pdf ; (4) the University's 'Guida all'iscrizione Anno accademico 2026-27', reachable from https://www.unina.it/didattica/sportello-studenti/guide-dello-studente , which sets the enrolment windows, fees, exemptions and surcharges; (5) for international applicants, the admission regulation https://www.international.unina.it/education/admission-regulation/ . REAL RECTORAL DECREES DO EXIST, BUT ONLY FOR THE DOUBLE DEGREES. These are genuine competitive calls with a cap of 3 places, an interview, a ranking and a forfeiture deadline. SOFIA (UACEG, Bulgaria), a.y. 2025/26: DR/2024/3960 of 25/09/2024, signed by Rector Matteo Lorito, 'BANDO PER L'AMMISSIONE AL PERCORSO DI FORMAZIONE FINALIZZATO AL RILASCIO DEL TITOLO DOPPIO DIPLOMA (DD): LAUREA MAGISTRALE IN INGEGNERIA PER L'AMBIENTE E IL TERRITORIO E MASTER DEGREE IN ENGINEERING ECOLOGY - ANNO ACCADEMICO 2025/26', at https://www.unina.it/documents/11958/56296489/double_degree_25-26_Sofia_2024-09-26_bando.pdf/ - based on the cooperation agreement signed 18/05/2022. KYUNGPOOK NATIONAL UNIVERSITY (Daegu, South Korea), a.y. 2026/27: https://www.unina.it/documents/d/guest/double_degree_spsb_knu_26_27_bando . The corresponding study programmes are published at https://www.iat.unina.it/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Study-program-Sofia.pdf and https://www.iat.unina.it/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Study-program-Daegu.pdf . [uncertain] THE 2027/2028 DOUBLE-DEGREE CALLS WERE ANNOUNCED BUT NOT YET PUBLISHED AS OF THE RESEARCH DATE. A programme news item dated 3 July 2026 states verbatim: "I bandi per la partecipazione, nell'a.a. 2027/2028, ai percorsi formativi di Double Degree con l'Universita di Sofia (Bulgaria) e con la Kyungpook National University di Daegu (Corea del Sud) - aperti agli studenti del Corso di Studio Magistrale in Ingegneria per l'Ambiente e il Territorio - stanno per essere pubblicati." As of 30 August 2026 neither had appeared at the expected unina.it document URLs. On the previous years' pattern, expect an application deadline around 30 November 2026 and a matriculation deadline around 31 December 2026. [uncertain] NO 2026-2027 DIDACTIC REGULATIONS EXIST YET. The most recent full Regolamento Didattico published on the quality-assurance page is the 2025-26 text; only the Manifesto degli Studi has a 2026/27 edition. Moreover the file the orientation portal labels 'Piano di studi 2026/2027' is byte-for-byte identical to the one it labels 'Piano di studi 2025/2026' apart from a single whitespace character, and its own cover reads "Regolamento proposto in vigore a partire dall'a.a. 2025-2026". The admission articles quoted throughout this record are therefore from the 2025-2026 text; they are reproduced verbatim on the current orientation portal page (which is headed 'Aggiornata a.a. 2026/2027'), so they are almost certainly still in force - but re-check when the 2026-2027 regulations are posted.
